title: Code determined by core data and output summary
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $C,D$ be configurations of $N$ on $x$. If their core data agree—their states, input-head positions, work-tape contents, and work-tape-head positions—and their output summaries agree, then their configuration codes for window size $s$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: Finite-state nondeterministic machine $N$ over binary alphabet
